In [[3962 BBY]], while the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] were invading [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] territory during the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the two '''clashed''' in the [[Nazzri system/Legends|Nazzri system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] undertook [[Mandalorian Triumph]], a campaign to capture the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. One prong of the advance took the Mandalorian forces from their territory to the [[Gizer system/Legends|Gizer system]]. Once they had [[Battle of the Gizer system (Mandalorian Wars)|conquered Gizer]], they moved on to the Nazzri [[Star system/Legends|system]], which they took during the battle. After Nazzri, the Mandalorians [[Battle of the Zel system|assaulted]] the [[Zel system]] and continued Coreward, eventually taking a number of other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Nazzri system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
